Ivy (new-hire): hi! day 1 here. trying to get Console access for staging + prod read-only so i can shadow the canary tomorrow. who should i ping? :wave:
Leo (people-ops): welcome Ivy! please open an access request with your SSO email and manager cc'd. paste the checklist items and i'll triage.
Ivy (new-hire): sso is ivy@redwood.ai, manager is Ravi. filing now.
access-bot: access ticket ACC-8301 created by Ivy at 2026-03-25T09:02:14Z.
Ravi (infra): for staging i can add you to `flags-developers` and grant `staging-operator` role immediately. prod read-only requires the short security checklist + manager attestation.
Ivy (new-hire): can you add staging now? want to poke the rollouts UI before shadowing.
Ravi (infra): done  added to `flags-developers` and `staging-operator`. allow ~20s to propagate.
Ivy (new-hire): seeing it, thanks! quick verification: Console -> Feature Flags -> Rollouts shows the list.
Maya (security): prod read-only (`flags-viewer`) will be provisioned after you complete orientation and we sign off. also reminder: prod destructive ops need paired oncall + runbook entry.
Ivy (new-hire): understood. Leo i added the checklist to the ticket, can you fast-track after Ravi approves?
Leo (people-ops): yup, i'll bump it once Ravi confirms manager attestation.
Ravi (infra): attested in the ticket. Ivy, for local checks you can use `redwood-ff list --env staging` and `redwood-ff preview <rollout>` to avoid triggering changes.
Ivy (new-hire): perfect, thanks everyone  this unblocks my first-week shadowing. :raised_hands:
Maya (security): ping me after orientation and i'll finish the prod sign-off.
Ivy (new-hire): will do. thanks!
